in_marathi.name: Dixit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dixit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dixit originates from the Sanskrit language and translates to 'he who speaks the truth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dixitah' meaning 'he declares, says'. This name is associated with honesty and integrity.
